definitions.explanation: An election in which all the seats of a legislature are contested at once. In Japan it means the election of the whole House of Representatives ({衆議院|しゅうぎいん}), held after a dissolution or when members' four-year terms end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a general election next month.

examples.japanese: {総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party won the general election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧し、{総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The prime minister dissolved the House of Representatives, and a general election is to be held.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a general election
- {総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出馬|しゅつば}→出馬：14954_shutsuba⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run in a general election
- ⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧{総選挙|そうせんきょ}: a general election following a dissolution
- {総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the result of the general election

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: election in general, of any size
- ⟦{補欠選挙|ほけつせんきょ}→補欠選挙：22076_hoketsusenkyo⟧: by-election, for a single vacant seat

CULTURAL NOTE:
The House of Councillors (⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧) is never elected all at once; half its seats are contested every three years, so its election is called {参院選|さんいんせん}, not {総選挙|そうせんきょ}.

cross_references.label: by-election, for a single vacant seat
